item.title: BookingPress Pro Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload via Data URI Signature Field (CVE-2026-6960)

Authentication Required No
Network Access Required Yes (HTTP to WordPress site running BookingPress Pro)

Summary

BookingPress Pro’s bookingpress_book_appointment_booking AJAX handler processes a signature-type custom field value as a data URI. The plugin extracts the file extension from the MIME-type portion of the URI via regex and passes it directly to file_put_contents() with no extension allowlist or blocklist, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to upload a PHP web shell to a web-accessible directory and achieve remote code execution. Exploitability requires a signature custom field configured in the booking form and at least one active service.
